posts.title: Neoliberalism has eaten everything except the bet.
posts.description: Neoliberalism has eaten everything except the bet. The current American economic landscape is defined by a pervasive, systemic shift toward speculation. This shift manifests in two seemingly disparate ways: the gambling scandals involving college athletes and the astronomical, often detached valuations of private aerospace firms like SpaceX.
